question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**offer**" means to present or provide something.
 
• In this context, families "offer guidance, share experiences, and create cherished memories," which means they provide these benefits.
 
• The other options: "**propose**", "**contribute**", and "**deliver**" do not fit the context as appropriately as "**offer**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Family plays a vital role in our lives, serving as a source of love, support, and stability. It is within the family unit that we develop lasting bonds, learn essential values, and find comfort during challenging times. Families provide a nurturing environment for personal growth and emotional well-being. They offer__ guidance, share experiences, and create cherished memories.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Propose (प्रस्तावित करना)**: means to put forward an idea or plan for consideration.
 
• **Contribute (योगदान देना)**: means to give something in order to help achieve or provide something.
 
• **Deliver (प्रदान करना)**: means to bring and hand over something to the proper recipient or address.
